struct Resource
  std::string handle
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
  Verification verification
struct OpenResult
  OpenOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Resource> resource
struct Chunk
  std::int64_t offset
  std::int64_t total
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> data
  bool eof
struct ReadResult
  ReadOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Chunk> chunk
struct CloseResult
  CloseOutcome outcome
struct Upload
  std::string handle
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
  std::int64_t received
struct Stored
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
  Evidence evidence
struct BeginResult
  BeginOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Upload> upload
  std::optional<Stored> stored
  std::int64_t limit
struct AppendResult
  AppendOutcome outcome
  std::int64_t received
struct CommitResult
  CommitOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Stored> stored
  std::int64_t received
struct AbortResult
  AbortOutcome outcome
struct Change
  std::int64_t sequence
  ChangeKind kind
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
struct ChangePage
  ChangePageOutcome outcome
  std::vector<Change> changes
  std::string next
  bool at_end
struct ListedObject
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
struct ListingPage
  ListingOutcome outcome
  std::vector<ListedObject> objects
  std::string continuation
  bool complete
  std::string cursor
struct Object
  std::string locator
  std::int64_t size
  std::string modified
  bool partial
  std::string digest
  Evidence evidence
struct Entry
  std::string role
  std::string digest
  std::int64_t size
  std::string media_type
  Evidence evidence
  std::string locator
  std::string manifest
  std::map<std::string, std::string> annotations
struct Name
  std::string scheme
  std::string name
struct Manifest
  std::string id
  Addressing addressing
  std::string kind
  std::vector<Entry> entries
  std::vector<Name> names
  std::map<std::string, std::string> descriptor
  std::string store
  std::string superseded_by
struct Holder
  std::string account
  std::string program
  std::string instance
  std::string established_by
  std::string domain
struct Basis
  std::string index
  std::string key
  std::string role
struct Hold
  std::string id
  Holder holder
  std::string target
  std::string purpose
  Lifetime lifetime
  std::string expires
  std::string attestation
  std::string observed_at
  std::optional<Basis> basis
struct Dangling
  Holder holder
  Basis basis
  std::string reference
  std::string expected_digest
  std::int64_t expected_size
  std::string observed_at
struct StoreError
  std::string kind
  std::string locator
  std::string detail
struct Store
  std::string name
  std::string program
  std::string locator
  std::string rule
  bool present
  std::vector<StoreError> errors
  Placement placement
  std::string domain
struct HoldResult
  HoldOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Hold> hold
struct ReleaseResult
  ReleaseOutcome outcome
struct RenewResult
  RenewOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Hold> hold
struct DescribeResult
  DescribeOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Manifest> manifest
struct PublishResult
  PublishOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Manifest> manifest
  std::vector<std::string> missing
struct ManifestHolders
  Manifest manifest
  std::vector<Hold> holds
struct ObjectHolders
  Object object
  std::string store
  std::vector<Hold> holds
struct InventoryPage
  InventoryOutcome outcome
  std::vector<Store> stores
  std::vector<ManifestHolders> manifests
  std::vector<ObjectHolders> objects
  std::vector<Dangling> dangling
  std::string continuation
  bool complete
  std::string cursor
  std::int64_t grace_ms
  std::int64_t audit_retention_ms
struct RemoveResult
  RemoveOutcome outcome
  std::vector<Holder> holders
struct SourceDescription
  SourceDescriptionOutcome outcome
  std::string name
  std::vector<Store> stores
  std::vector<std::string> schemes
  std::vector<std::string> capabilities
struct SourceChange
  std::int64_t sequence
  SourceChangeKind kind
  std::string target
  std::optional<Hold> hold
  std::optional<Store> store
struct SourcePage
  SourcePageOutcome outcome
  std::vector<Store> stores
  std::vector<ManifestHolders> manifests
  std::vector<ObjectHolders> objects
  std::vector<Dangling> dangling
  std::vector<SourceChange> changes
  std::string continuation
  bool complete
  std::string cursor

  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)

struct ContentReader
  virtual OpenResult open(const std::string& digest)
  virtual ReadResult read(const std::string& handle, const std::int64_t& offset, const std::int64_t& max_bytes)
  virtual CloseResult close(const std::string& handle)
template<class Transport>struct ContentReaderClient : ContentReader
  Transport& transport_
  OpenResult open(const std::string& digest) override
  ReadResult read(const std::string& handle, const std::int64_t& offset, const std::int64_t& max_bytes) override
  CloseResult close(const std::string& handle) override
struct ContentReaderService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct ContentReaderDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  ContentReader& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct ContentWriter
  virtual BeginResult begin(const std::string& request, const std::string& digest, const std::int64_t& size)
  virtual AppendResult append(const std::string& handle, const std::int64_t& offset, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data)
  virtual CommitResult commit(const std::string& handle)
  virtual AbortResult abort(const std::string& handle)
template<class Transport>struct ContentWriterClient : ContentWriter
  Transport& transport_
  BeginResult begin(const std::string& request, const std::string& digest, const std::int64_t& size) override
  AppendResult append(const std::string& handle, const std::int64_t& offset, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data) override
  CommitResult commit(const std::string& handle) override
  AbortResult abort(const std::string& handle) override
struct ContentWriterService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct ContentWriterDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  ContentWriter& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override

struct Inventory

  virtual InventoryPage holders(const std::string& target)

  virtual InventoryPage find(const std::string& digest)
template<class Transport>struct InventoryClient : Inventory
  Transport& transport_
  InventoryPage list(const std::string& continuation, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  InventoryPage holders(const std::string& target) override
  InventoryPage unheld(const std::string& continuation, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  InventoryPage find(const std::string& digest) override

struct InventorySource
  virtual SourceDescription describe()
  virtual SourcePage snapshot(const std::string& continuation, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual SourcePage observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_changes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual SourcePage verify(const std::string& target)
  virtual RemoveResult remove(const std::string& target)
template<class Transport>struct InventorySourceClient : InventorySource
  Transport& transport_
  SourceDescription describe() override
  SourcePage snapshot(const std::string& continuation, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  SourcePage observe(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_changes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
  SourcePage verify(const std::string& target) override
  RemoveResult remove(const std::string& target) override
struct InventorySourceService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct InventorySourceDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  InventorySource& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
